mapper.sql: select id, plan_id, code_digest, code_mask, status, used_user_id, used_time, expires_time, batch_no, vip_entitlement_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from wl_vip_code
mapper.select: where code_digest = #{digest} and del_flag = '0' for update
mapper.insert: insert into wl_vip_code(plan_id, code_digest, code_mask, status, expires_time, batch_no, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, remark) values(#{planId}, #{codeDigest}, #{codeMask}, #{status}, #{expiresTime}, #{batchNo}, #{createBy}, now(), '', now(), '0', #{remark})
mapper.update: update wl_vip_code set status = 'USED', used_user_id = #{userId}, used_time = now(), vip_entitlement_id = #{vipEntitlementId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'UNUSED' and del_flag = '0'
update wl_vip_code set status = 'DISABLED', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'UNUSED' and del_flag = '0'
